## Recap from last week

- Introduction to Shiny
- Anatomy of Shiny Apps
- Reactivity: reactive expressions; observers

Tips 

- Use `reactlog::reactlog_enable()` to debug
- Always test small components first
- [Shiny cheatsheet](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/shiny.pdf)

Short cuts

- Type `shinyapp` (from `snippet` package)
- From menu: `File > New File > Shiny Web App...`
- Click on "Run App"; `Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + Enter`
